# Replica Build , rebuild an app screen by screen, clean-room style

Curated by Skill Harbor: the build step of the 11-skill Replica pack: rebuild an app screen by screen from the recon map. App shell with routing and tokens first, then the core loop as an end-to-end vertical slice (ugly is fine, working is the point), then every screen with every state (empty, loading, error, mobile), one commit per screen, ticking off the feature matrix as it goes. by @Jakeschincariol, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: strictly clean-room, every line written fresh, never the original's code, assets, copy or CDN; works from the recon map, architecture and design specs, so it pairs with the other Replica skills (recon first). Keeps a build log and says out loud when a feature is bigger than it looked. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via GitHub.
